items.root_cause: (a) test-match-lib's two class-reach checks computed their arithmetic inline over the live rule files, so the MECHANISM had no frozen proof and the audit could not tell the deliberate live invariant (Brad's 'Fix all produce' ruling is a property of the live rules) from an accidental dependency; the two alert-registry reads are code-versus-registry contracts that were never declared. (b) audit-write-only-reports keyed a family on its literal leaf, so a DATED instance was its own family and a wildcard reader named none: a detector defect, not a new report nobody reads.

root_fix.what: (a) the class-reach arithmetic is one pure function driven over frozen rule slices (MUST FIRE, MUST NOT FIRE, CLEAN TWIN) and then over the live files under a LIVE-TWIN declaration with its reason; the two registry contract reads are declared LIVE-TWIN with theirs. (b) a dated leaf and a '-*' wildcard leaf both fold to one '<stem>-<date>' family, fixtured, and the fall recorded with -Tighten by NAME.
root_fix.exact_change: test-match-lib: Get-ProduceClassReach($CeLib,$Cats,$CmById) returns reach/want/missing/canMiss; 4 frozen cases over inline slices; the live assertions and rtWant=35 unchanged. audit-write-only-reports: WOR_PATH_RX admits a trailing '-*', Get-ReportFamilies folds -yyyy-MM-dd and -* to -<date>; 3 new self-test cases. Baseline 41 -> 34, names removed: comparison-2026-01-01/01-02/01-08/08-26/09-02, verify-verdicts-2026-07-17/08-15; names added: none.

items.deviation: The dispatch asked to freeze test-match-lib's inputs. Freezing categories.json and category-excludes.json alone, beside the live commodities.json the same check reads, would have blinded the check it carries (the next produce commodity added without the class would pass). So the MECHANISM is frozen and the INVARIANT stays live and declared. apply-coverage-batch has no self-test and every run of it edits commodities.json and rebuilds a board, so its 'routing check' was not run: could not verify it without a board rebuild; test-match-lib's 35 routing fixtures are the routing proof instead.
